|translation='''Title:''' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three).

'''Card text:''' If the opponent declares a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent site, you may react by deploying cards to that location. Deploy cost is paid as normal.

'''Lore:''' A CZ communications droid made by Serv-O-Droid. An old model but widely used. It has a built-in comlink with an excellent scrambler and encryption.
